opening: My face and neck are very swollen.
There's blood in the whites of both my eyes.
I passed out once, during a coughing attack.
At first I was told I probably had allergic asthma.
I was treated with inhalers to open my airways, steroid tablets and antihistamines, and none of it helped.
I spent 14 days in a local hospital before I was sent here.

opening.text: I've been short of breath, coughing, and my face and neck are very swollen. Both started six weeks ago. I passed out once during a coughing attack, and there's blood in the whites of both my eyes. At first I was told I probably had allergic asthma, but the inhalers, steroid tablets, and antihistamines didn't help. I spent 14 days in a local hospital before I was sent here.
